battletag.title: Hidden, your BattleTag can only be read in the “Contacts” window of your Overwatch matches, in their launch window and, if you cast or referee an Overwatch match, on its page:
battletag.match: if you're shown there as a contact: the members of both teams, referees and administrators, from the moment the opponents are known until the end of the match, and the casters while the match is being played;
battletag.asCaster: if you cast a match: both its teams and its other casters while the match is being played, and referees and administrators from the moment its opponents are known until its end;
battletag.asReferee: if you are the assigned referee of a match: both its teams, referees and administrators from the moment its opponents are known until its end, and its casters while the match is being played;
battletag.launch: the launch window only opens for both teams, the casters and the assigned referee; the match page repeats the BattleTag of its casters and its assigned referee, to the same people at the same times as the “Contacts” window.
battletag.footer: To stop sharing it entirely, clear it from your profile (if it comes from Battle.net, unlink Battle.net first, after adding another way to log in if it is your only one).
